evaluation_contract: source-faithful Wave-1 §18 semantics specialized to exact CORE-GAME-MODEL-v2; specialization may add diagnostics but may not weaken source predicates

rules.pass: at least two trajectory_evidence records, each foundational_checkpoints_pass AND medium_goal_pass AND long_goal_pass; at least two distinct primary systems; every counted trajectory systems_used>=3; exact model/graph/policy identities bound by manifest
same sustained foundational/medium/long trajectory evidence as GDF-E1, with >=3 materially distinct policy/primary-system route mixes and distinct specialization goals; labels alone insufficient

optimizer_search_evidence executes independent+joint objectives; max_objectives_won<=2; every winning policy has material opportunity_cost_evidence; exploit_search_evidence contains no seeded DEFECT classified BENIGN
same finite optimizer/search evidence as GDF-E2, including joint_and_independent_objectives_executed=true, opportunity-cost evidence, and anomaly/exploit distinction
all four trajectory traces are bound to early/mid/mature checkpoints 8/16/24 and max_low_decision_run<=5 for every trajectory; no hidden actions
automation winner_counts contains manual>=1, partial>=1, strong>=1; new_decisions strictly increases manual<partial<strong; no tier is universal

for every persona, four source_sink_lifecycle cycles complete with no_negative_state=true and post_caps_respected=true; all three stock resources have declared source actions and meaningful ambition sink conversion
same automation sweep as GDF-E4 plus exact setup/maintenance/output/attention model identity; different tiers are rational in different tested regions
switching_evidence covers multiple source/target pairs and stages; every case has 1..8 recovery turns, nonnegative=true, target_viable_entry_goal_pass=true, permanent_damage=false
all required branch goals have retained base paths; every declared mutation result equals its expected detector class; intentional_exclusion_explained=true
persona_benchmark_evidence retains four policy-class trajectory refs, unique_primary_families>=3, aggregation_preserves_each_policy=true

each exploit fixture has an actual search_trace, observed classification equals expected from manifest fixture, seeded defect cases identify a declared invariant violation, benign efficient case has no violation

authority: bounded engine-neutral abstract planning evidence only; PASS is not human fun/preference, final balance, production, release, engine, readiness, verification, or canonical authority
